'''La Alta''' is a dialect of Lojban.
=Differences not breaking past usage=
*'''ki'au''' is an interjection for commands
*cmavo with diphthongs "V'V" can be pronounced as "V" if it's illegal except when the last V is '''o'''. E.g. '''tu'a''' => '''tua''', '''ku'i''' => '''kui'''. But '''a'o''' doesn't change since the last vowel is '''o'''.
